coverage: First-round reference profile; identification and biographical details await review.

attestations.text: LUNGKODO 隆科多, d. 1728, official, was the third son of T'ung Kuo-wei [q. v.], and a member of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner. His aunt was the mother of Emperor Shêng-tsu. That emperor took two of Lungkodo's sisters as concubines, one of whom was elevated to empress (Empress Hsiao-i, see under T'ung Kuo-wei) shortly before her death in 1689.
隆科多，佟佳氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人，一等公佟國維子，孝懿仁皇后弟也。
